About this Event

4 Paws in the Park: Bergen County Pet & Adoption Festival

Get ready for a good old-fashioned day in the park, only this one is going to the dogs...and cats.

4 Paws in the Park is taking over Overpeck County Park for a FREE outdoor pet and adoption festival bringing together animal lovers, local pet businesses, veterinary professionals, rescue organizations, adoptable cats and dogs, and plenty of four-legged fun.
Whether you’re hoping to meet a new furry family member, show off your pup in the pet parade, discover local pet businesses, or simply spend the afternoon surrounded by fellow animal lovers, come make a day of it.

ALL THINGS PET, ALL IN ONE PLACEOur pets are family, and taking care of them involves a whole community.
Hosted by Tenafly Veterinary Center + Overpeck Creek Animal Hospital (NJVet) in partnership with T.H. Experiences LLC, 4 Paws in the Park brings that community together for one afternoon at Overpeck County Park.
Meet local pet businesses and service providers, connect with veterinary professionals, discover rescue and adoption organizations, shop pet-friendly vendors, and learn about resources for keeping your pets happy and healthy.
And yes, there’s plenty happening just for fun, too.

WHAT’S HAPPENING🐾 MEET ADOPTABLE CATS + DOGS
Looking for a new best friend? Meet adoptable cats and dogs and connect with local rescue and adoption organizations helping them find their forever homes.
